name: Webflow
summary: Visual website builder with CMS, hosting, localisation and SEO/AEO tools.
description: Webflow is a visual platform for designing, building and hosting websites without writing code. It includes a CMS, interactions, localisation, shared libraries, analytics, optimisation and SEO and answer-engine (AEO) features, and recently added Campaigns for marketing teams. Users can build on a webflow.io domain for free; the Basic site plan costs $15 per month billed yearly. Plans are split between site plans and workspace plans for teams, with enterprise options handled by sales.

howToUse.title: Open Webflow
howToUse.description: Open Webflow and start for free. You can build on a webflow.io domain before choosing a site plan.

howToUse.title: Design and build the site
howToUse.description: Start designing and building on this visual platform, without writing code, then add interactions and the CMS.

howToUse.title: Host, localize, and optimize
howToUse.description: Turn on hosting for the websites. Add localisation and the shared libraries, then check analytics. Optimisation, SEO, and the answer engine (AEO) sit in the same platform.

howToUse.title: Add Campaigns or talk to sales
howToUse.description: Plans are split between site plans and workspace plans. Basic costs $15 a month when billed yearly. Sales handles enterprise options. Campaigns was recently added for marketing teams.
